cases.disposition_reason: Holla activities-multi at 120×40 in truecolor with reduced motion and HOLLA_NO_HISTORY=1 opens the finder. Ctrl+W on Here sets Here cannot be closed · Ctrl+Q quits and does not open Quit holla. q is finder query text and the process stays running. Backspace restores Search actions. Ctrl+G, Enter opens frontend dev. Ctrl+W opens Stop frontend dev? with Keep running focused and Stop and close as the danger button. Enter keeps the tab, the header still shows http://localhost:5173/, and the status is not Stopping · the tab closes once the process is gone. Ctrl+Q opens Quit holla❯?. Right, Enter activates Stop and quit. A following Ctrl+Q exits 0 and restores the terminal.
cases.entry_path: launch holla --scenario activities-multi --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40; Ctrl+W on Here; q in the finder; Ctrl+G, Enter on frontend dev; Ctrl+W, Enter on Keep running
cases.return_path: Right, Enter on Stop and quit; Ctrl+Q exits 0

cases.disposition_reason: Paused activities-multi leaves api tests running, so the completed close is parity-task-input: Quick no-op runs true, reaches succeeded and exit 0, and Ctrl+W closes that tab with no Stop dialog and without starting Deploy the release. On activities-multi with paused motion, Ctrl+G, Enter opens frontend dev and Ctrl+Q opens Quit holla❯? with Stay, Stop and quit, and the body that activities are still running and detached monitors keep going. That dialog is captured at 120×40, then at 80×24, and the narrow shot is taken before the terminal returns to 120×40. Enter activates Stay. frontend dev stays open, http://localhost:5173/ remains, and the status is not Stopping · the tab closes once the process is gone. Esc returns to Here, q is query text, and no quit dialog opens. Ctrl+Q again and Right, Enter choose Stop and quit. fixtures::base leaves clock.running false when motion is paused, and World::tick returns before self.tick advances, so a cancelling activity never reaches TERM_EXIT_TICKS on that launch. The same Stop and quit on activities-multi with reduced motion exits 0 and restores the terminal.
